title: fontainea pancheri
intro: Fontainea pancheri, commonly known as the Tamanu tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Euphorbiaceae. It is a tropical evergreen tree native to the Pacific Islands, valued for its oil-rich seeds, which are used in traditional medicine. The oil from the Tamanu tree has been found to have various health benefits, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents present in the oil include calophyllic acid, tamandin, and others, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and anti-cancer properties.
